answer: An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the vine index resolves every citation against the cedar checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the whisper audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 215 aliases as a result pays the authoring cost 215 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
